tool_args.rationale: Acquire the specified trajectory batch to obtain at least eight observations and identify the four parameters of the irregular-history coupled ODE.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five trajectories leave the four coupled parameters insufficiently identified for reliable forecasting.
The verified mechanism and irregular-prefix guidance point directly to the coupled memory model; additional trajectories are needed to identify its parameters.
The observed history gap and coupled transient lag favor a history-conditioned model.
